company_overview.what_they_do: Adani Realty is the real estate arm of the Adani Group, founded in 2010, developing residential, commercial and social club projects in Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Pune and Gurugram. It has completed about 24 million sq ft and has 61 million sq ft under development, including integrated townships (Shantigram), luxury high-rises and commercial parks. Revenue for FY26 exceeded Rs 1,000 crore. It is expanding in Mumbai through new luxury launches and large JV/redevelopment mandates such as Monte South in Byculla and the Dharavi rehabilitation project.

ai_opportunities.title: AI lead follow-up and price-transparency concierge for 4 Mumbai launches
ai_opportunities.problem_solved: High-ticket enquiries across WhatsApp, callbacks, forms, brokers and NRI investors suffer slow first response, inconsistent pricing answers and manual follow-up, which lengthens sales cycles.
ai_opportunities.applies_to: WhatsApp, callback and enquiry-form leads for Adani Verve, Linkbay Residences Phase II Wing B, Reform Heights and Adani Triumph, including broker and NRI referrals routed into the sales CRM.
ai_opportunities.ai_mechanism: Retrieval-augmented LLM assistant plus lead scoring. It retrieves from price sheets, live inventory, MahaRERA registration details and payment-plan documents, then answers on WhatsApp with the correct project RERA number, price band, available configurations and site-visit slots. It writes qualified lead scores, visit bookings and follow-up tasks to the CRM, and hands off to a human for negotiation, commercial approvals and site visits.
